related_questions.question: Where do I apply for unemployment in Florida?

text_blocks.snippet: To apply for unemployment benefits in Florida, you need to file a claim with the Florida Department of Economic Opportunity (DEO) online at FloridaJobs.org. You can also visit a CareerSource Florida center for assistance, according to CareerSource Florida.

list.title: 1. Online Application:
list.snippet: The primary way to apply is through the FloridaJobs.org website, specifically the Reemployment Assistance Claim application portal.

list.title: 2. Required Information:
list.snippet: When applying, you'll need to provide information such as your Social Security number, driver's license or state ID number, details about your employment history over the past 18 months, and your employer's Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN).

list.title: 3. CareerSource Florida:
list.snippet: If you need assistance with the application process or prefer in-person support, visit CareerSource Florida to find your nearest center.

list.title: 4. Hurricane Milton Assistance:
list.snippet: FloridaJobs.org also provides information and resources for those affected by Hurricane Milton who are seeking Disaster Unemployment Assistance.
